title: Button Debouncer
constraints: `clean` changes to the value of `btn` only after `btn` differed from `clean` on **4 consecutive** rising edges. The 4th such edge updates `clean`.
Any edge where `btn == clean` restarts the count.
`clean` is registered. The synchronous reset sets `clean = 0` and clears the count.
hints: Keep a small counter of consecutive samples that disagree with `clean`.
Clear the counter whenever the sample agrees with `clean`, and also when `clean` flips.
A 2-bit counter is enough: flip `clean` when it would reach 4.

examples.title: bounce
examples.expected: clean only rises after the final run of four 1s
